name: Dynamic Island
author: Akshit
description: An interactive dynamic island bar pill that expands on hover to show now playing tracks, media controls, and quick system events.

barWidget.description: Dynamic island bar pill with hover expansion and media controls

schema.label: Hover Open Delay (ms)
schema.description: Delay in milliseconds before expanding the panel on cursor hover.

schema.label: Hover Close Delay (ms)
schema.description: Delay in milliseconds before closing the panel after cursor leaves.

schema.label: Panel Width (px)
schema.description: Width in pixels for the expanded dynamic island panel.

schema.label: Preferred Player
schema.description: Optional MPRIS identity to prioritize when multiple media players are active (e.g. Spotify, Apple Music, VLC).
